chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who performs continuous fasting fasts for a day and a night, and breaks his fast in the pre-dawn hours.
ai.seo_question: What is the definition and ruling of continuous fasting (Muwasal) in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi defines 'Muwasal' as continuous fasting for a full day and night cycle, with the fast broken specifically during the pre-dawn hours (Sahar). In Shia jurisprudence, this practice is often associated with the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his progeny) and is considered a recommended act of devotion, though it is not obligatory to maintain it indefinitely without breaking the fast periodically.
